description: The Entra registration has no validate arm in prov_arm(): its preflight calls Microsoft Graph (ADR-0033).

patches.replace:
validate/entra)
        SAF_ENTRA_JSON="$(cat "$inputs")" az deployment group validate --resource-group "$where" --name "$name" \
          --parameters "$prov_entra_param" --only-show-errors --output json > "$out" 2> "$err"
        ;;
      create/entra)
